title: design.submit and design.read are published and reachable by a seat
description:
SPIDR child 1b of task-8a6d6660c31c4e119f962d13e6f1505d, split out by architect-20a6d1eb 2026-09-05 when child 1a's roster measured 11 distinct files against the 10-file hard cap. Cut along the INTERFACE axis: task-5e90317e80ac4b86a9704b6b8ba8874a owns the CONTRACT and the versioned AGGREGATE; this row PUBLISHES the two kinds and makes them reachable.

dependsOn task-5e90317e80ac4b86a9704b6b8ba8874a - the kinds dispatch into its store.

THESE ARE SEAT KINDS, THE EXCEPTION ON THIS BOARD. Every other kind this epic adds is human-only and MCP-EXCLUDED. `design.submit` is submitted BY AN AGENT and `design.read` is read by seats AND the operator, so both must be REACHABLE over MCP. Copying the approval.decide / escalation.decide pattern here would make the design step unstaffable while looking correct in review - that is the single most likely failure of this row.

THE TWO KINDS TAKE DIFFERENT ROUTES TO BEING SERVED, measured at HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04):
- `mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:87-89` builds the served set as ALL command kinds MINUS `MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS` (:59), PLUS `MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS` (:27). So `design.submit`, being a COMMAND, is served by simply NOT being added to the exclusion roster - there is no positive action, and the mistake would be adding it there out of habit.
- `design.read` is a QUERY: it must be ADDED to `MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS` (:27, beside product_contract.read, graph.get, events.read, documents.source_read) AND given a handler in the dispatch map at `mcp-dispatch-port.ts:302` (`"product_contract.read": answerProductContractRead` is the shape). A query in the roster with no handler advertises a capability the port cannot serve.

DAEMON ROSTER: daemon-command-vocabulary.ts (kind, capability, family, PAYLOAD_KEYS), daemon-command-families.ts (the per-kind flag block :83-94), daemon-command-registry.ts (`entryOf` :205-212). TWO PAYLOAD-KEY TEST TABLES must both gain rows and are invisible to a grep for the kind literal: daemon-command-vocabulary.test.ts (~:170-182) and daemon-command-registry.test.ts (~:197-203 plus the flat roster ~:283-300).

THE SHARED CONTRACT AND THE GENERATED CLIENT (packages/contracts runtime-vocabulary + `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`) are needed only when the BROWSER must dispatch these kinds. The operator reads the design through child 3's screen; decide at plan time whether that needs the generated client, and if so include it - never hand-edit it, since it pins GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST checked at client-compat.ts:169.
definitionOfDone: `design.submit` and `design.read` are published across the daemon roster (vocabulary kind/capability/family/PAYLOAD_KEYS, families flag, registry entry) with a BIDIRECTIONAL set-equality test enumerating the SERVED kinds from the dispatch seam; verify by deleting each entry from each side in turn and confirming all four deletions go red.

BOTH ARE SEAT-REACHABLE OVER MCP, asserted behaviourally rather than by roster membership: an AGENT-authenticated dispatch of `design.submit` REACHES the handler, and an agent-authenticated `design.read` returns its answer. This is the opposite of every other kind this epic adds, and the arm exists because copying the human-only pattern would make the design step unstaffable while passing review.
`design.submit` is NOT in `MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS` and NOT in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS - assert both absences explicitly, since each is a place a well-meaning worker would add it by habit.

`design.read` is in `MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS` (mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:27) AND has a handler in the dispatch map (mcp-dispatch-port.ts:302 area). Assert BOTH: a query advertised without a handler promises a capability the port cannot serve, and the allowlist's own parity test compares the roster against the port's table.

Both payload-key TEST tables gain their rows (daemon-command-vocabulary.test.ts and daemon-command-registry.test.ts, including its flat kind roster) - these are invisible to a grep for the kind literal in production source and have cost this board a rejected plan before.

If the browser must dispatch either kind, packages/contracts' runtime vocabulary and the REGENERATED client move with it (`pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`, quoting the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST). If it need not, say so explicitly in the record rather than leaving it ambiguous for child 3.
Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, plus `pnpm test` if packages/ was touched.
taskRails: SEAT KINDS, NOT HUMAN GATES. Do not add `design.submit` to MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS or HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS. The surrounding pattern invites exactly that mistake and it would silently make the design step unstaffable.
A SERVED QUERY NEEDS BOTH a roster entry and a dispatch handler. One without the other is an advertised capability the port cannot serve.
NO AGGREGATE WORK: the contract and the versioned store are task-5e90317e80ac4b86a9704b6b8ba8874a's. No wrapper, no mission, no UI.
NEVER HAND-EDIT the generated client; run the generator and quote both digests.
FEATURES ONLY (inherited): no security-boundary or policy work.

implementationPlan.description: VERIFY, NO EDITS. (a) Confirm the producer: apps/daemon/src/design/design-store.ts exports submitDesignRevision and readDesignRevision; design-contracts.ts has DESIGN_CODE_LAYERS / designRefusal taking no layer argument. (b) Confirm the gap: grep design.submit / design.read in daemon-command-vocabulary.ts, runtime-vocabulary.ts, PAYLOAD_KEYS — ZERO roster hits (the store file's commandKind string does not count). (c) Re-measure the LIVE counts this row increments: ROWS.toHaveLength(N) in vocabulary.test.ts:243 and registry.test.ts:818, REGISTRATION_ORDER length, OPERATOR_ONLY length (must NOT increment — this kind is not operator-only), store-deps registryKinds length, RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS size literal in runtime-contract.test.ts:105, RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS array at :93. preview.decide (task-40e52fa8) may already have bumped 46→47; write the measured N in the step note and increment from THAT, not from this plan's memory of 46. (d) Confirm dependsOn task-40e52fa8 is DONE before editing the shared roster; if still WORKING, you should not have been claimed — report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds naming it. (e) If a file outside planningNotes.keyFiles appears, STOP. MCP allowlist and mcp-dispatch-port.ts are task-7f9f20c7.

LEAF FIRST — shared runtime roster + generated client. (1) packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts: insert "design.submit" in RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS sorted (after dependency.challenge, before effect.activate) and "design.read" in RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS sorted (after dependency.explain, before doctor.get). They must stay disjoint. (2) packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-contract.test.ts: the same inserts in EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS and the inline RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS expectation at :93; bump the command size literal at :105 by one from the measured N. Do NOT derive EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS from the tuple. (3) Record OLD GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST from generated-client.ts:905. Run `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`. NEVER hand-edit generated-client.ts. (4) Update GENERATED_FILE_SHA256 and CONTRACT_DIGEST in generated-coverage.test.ts. Quote OLD and NEW digest; unchanged means generate did not see the kinds. contract-pins.ts only re-exports — do not edit it.

WIRE design.submit INTO THE DAEMON VOCABULARY. apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts only. Add "design.submit" to WiredCommandKind. Add DESIGN_FAMILY = { "design.submit": CAPABILITIES.PLANNING } and put it in FAMILY_TABLES. PAYLOAD_KEYS["design.submit"] = ["contractRef","expectedVersion","goalRef","revision"] (sorted; caller intent only — commandId/correlationId/decidedAt/principalId/projectId are server facts). Put the key in the literal at the position REGISTRATION_ORDER will transcribe. agentCapabilitiesFor returns [PLANNING, WORK] like planning.submit_decomposition. Do NOT add it to OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS, HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS, MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS, REVIEW_FAMILY, or COMPILER_FAMILY. Do not edit design-contracts.ts (259 lines, owned by task-5e90317e). Stay under 400 lines.

SERVE design.submit. (1) daemon-command-families.ts: add design: boolean to CommandFamilyFacts and membershipOf (design: kind === "design.submit"). requiredCapabilityOf: if member.design return CAPABILITIES.PLANNING. schemaVersion stays on the BOOTSTRAP default. Do not set compilerDecompose or review. (2) daemon-command-registry.ts: file is already 436 lines — keep this tiny, do NOT add daemon-command-edges.ts. Destructure design from commandFamilyFacts. Before the compilerDecompose branch: if (design) { assemble DesignSubmitInput from envelope + principal (goalRef, contractRef, revision, expectedVersion from payload; commandId/correlationId from envelope; decidedAt from clock(); principalId/projectId from auth); if expectedVersion is not a finite number throw DomainRefusal("DESIGN_SHAPE_INVALID", "REQUEST", ...); const result = submitDesignRevision(store, input); if (!result.ok) throw new DomainRefusal(result.code, result.layer, result.code); return { commandId, disposition: "DECIDED", effectId: designAggregateId(goalRef), resultCode: "DESIGN_REVISION_COMMITTED" }. } Layer MUST come from the DesignRefusal, never a literal. Do not call decisionOf — DesignSubmitResult is not in that union.

ROSTER TESTS. Re-measure N from step 1; every 46-or-47 below means N, N+1 after this row. (1) daemon-command-vocabulary.test.ts ROWS: agent [PLANNING, WORK], capability PLANNING, family STANDALONE (or DESIGN if you add the label — STANDALONE is already used and FAMILY_NAMES does not include it, matching cutover), kind design.submit, payloadKeys ["contractRef","expectedVersion","goalRef","revision"]. Length N→N+1. OPERATOR_ONLY length MUST stay the same; assert HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS.has("design.submit") === false and MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS does not contain it (import those from their modules into this already-owned test file). (2) daemon-command-registry.test.ts ROWS: empty payload → DESIGN_SHAPE_INVALID @ REQUEST; REGISTRATION_ORDER transcribes PAYLOAD_KEYS key order, length N→N+1. Existing :818-821 is the bidirectional served-vs-advertised check. (3) daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts registryKinds: insert "design.submit" sorted. File may be dirty from peers; preserve foreign hunks. design.read is a QUERY — it does not belong in these command tables.

DRILLS, GATES, SELF-REVIEW. (a) git status --porcelain the exact paths first. Tracked files restore with empty git diff. (i) Remove design.submit from RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS only — contract test and registry typecheck/set-equality go red. (ii) Remove it from PAYLOAD_KEYS only — registry.keys() vs ROWS goes red. (iii) Add it to OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS or MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS only — the absence asserts from step 5 go red. Restore after each. (b) GATES, standalone foreground, quote Test Files N passed: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test`, `pnpm typecheck`. Root `pnpm test` is real evidence (contracts + client). Attribute foreign daemon red by merge-base/HEAD ∩ owned paths. Named complete_task command: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`. (c) Adversarial: agent principal reaches the handler; operator-only/MCP-excluded absences hold; empty payload is DESIGN_SHAPE_INVALID @ REQUEST not a bootstrap code; generated digest changed; no 11th file. Completion record: design.read is on RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS and the generated client but is NOT MCP-served until task-7f9f20c7; design.submit is MCP-served by derivation from PAYLOAD_KEYS.
